text:
Sofia: Quick follow-up from the PM yesterday — we need a lightweight weekly ledger for postmortem tickets so nothing slips between sprints.
Devon: +1. Want to avoid the monthly blob where things pile up.
Ravi: Can someone propose a template? I suggest: ticket, owner, RACI (R/A/C/I), due date, risk level, recurrence flag.
Lee: I made a quick Jira filter that we can reuse: `project = INF AND labels = postmortem AND status != Done ORDER BY priority DESC`
Carla: Nice. Can we also tag recurring incidents with `recurrence=pattern` (e.g., cpu-killer, cache-evict)? That helps triage across PMs.
Sofia: Yes. Let's map current open PM tickets this week into that ledger and assign owners. I'll volunteer to host the spreadsheet for two sprints.
Devon: Ops-bot created ticket INF-5123 for the kernel memory pressure follow-up yesterday — assigning provisional owner @Ravi.
ops-bot: Bot: INF-5123 was created by incident-bridge. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-5123
Ravi: I'll take INF-5123. ETA end of next week. Plan: reproduce in staging with the same sequence lengths, add a memory profiler, test kv-cache leak hypothesis.
Carla: For RACI: Ravi = R/A, Lee = C (infra perf), Devon = I (product impact), Sofia = A (PM verify closure).
Sofia: Can you add a smaller remediation ticket if it looks like a config tweak? We prefer quick rollouts vs big refactors.
Ravi: Yep. If it's config I'll open INF-5124 (patch + canary).
Devon: Also flag any ticket that needs Dedicated capacity changes — those require procurement lead times.
Lee: Agreed. I'll annotate tickets with `capex-needed` if model shard changes are required.
Sofia: Cadence proposal: weekly ledger review on Tuesdays 10am PT (30m), owners update status in Jira before the meeting.
Carla: Works for me. Can we automate a Slack digest from the filter above with the top 5 active PM tickets?
Devon: I can wire a scheduled webhook to post the filter results to #postmortems. Want it to include owner, due date, and recurrence flag.
Sofia: Perfect. Actionables from this thread:
- Sofia: host ledger (2 sprints) and invite owners (due: today EOD)
- Ravi: own INF-5123, diagnostic run + decision (due: next Fri)
- Devon: scheduled Slack digest from Jira filter (due: Tue morning)
- Lee: mark capex-needed tickets and add infra touchpoints (due: Wed)
- Carla: add recurrence tags to historical PM tickets (ongoing)

Devon: I'll create INF-5130 as the automation task for the digest and link the filter.
ops-bot: Bot: INF-5130 created. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-5130
Ravi: Small note — if INF-5123 reproduces only under very long sequences, call it `recurrence=long-seq` so we don't conflate with other cpu-killers.
Carla: Thanks. I'll start tagging older tickets this afternoon.
Sofia: Great sync — we'll take the ledger live next Tuesday. If anything blocks owners from updating Jira before the meeting, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
Lee: :eyes: I'll start scanning for Dedicated-related items and loop in procurement if needed.
Devon: I'll post the digest to #postmortems and also copy the ledger link.
Sofia: Closing the thread here — expect the first digest on Tue AM.
Carla: Thanks everyone.
Devon: Thanks!
